global: MAJOR (sound): narration chunk-split artifacts. Ten clips carry ghost syllables from neighbouring lines (e.g. L0704's tail holds L0705's onset; the heads of L0105, L0204, L0522, L0810, L1216, L1524, L1307b; the tails of L0319, L0401). In the narrate split step, cut at the minimum-energy point between the last word end and the next word start, add 15-30 ms fades, and require edge peaks below -50 dBFS. Re-narrate singly any line with no clean gap. Make the clipEdges QA a FAIL above -45 dBFS.

MAJOR (sound): cue transitions are buried. 17 of 20 crossfades sit under a chapter's first line. Move each incoming cue's start (and the outgoing end) 1.5-3s earlier, so the new key and colour sounds in the clear before the chapter opens. Where the clock has no gap, add a 1.5-2s head-hold at the ch02, ch03, ch05, ch08, ch10, ch14 and ch15 openers.

MAJOR (art): silhouette craft. (a) Give each recurring real person a distinct silhouette signature in cast.ts (hair mass, glasses, beard, posture, height, period coat cut), with rim-light edges and 2-3 interior cut lines, so Hinton, LeCun, Bengio and Hassabis read apart at a glance. (b) Require at least 3 depth planes with parallax on every camera move. Add a shared foreground occluder layer (drapery, chair backs, fretwork, mullions) and cut-paper filigree to the recurring sets (study, Case Board, candle shelf, jetty). (c) Restyle the X-ray column as a backlit vellum lightbox cabinet: paper grain, teal at about 40% saturation, cut-out band glyphs, and a black cut-card frame. It currently reads as a cyan digital UI widget (ch11-s05, ch12-s01/s07/s08, ch13-s06, ch15-s04).

MAJOR (art + teacher): legibility. Set a kit-wide minimum of about 22px cap height at 1080p for any text the viewer must read, and push in whenever a card is the subject (Case Board cards, the ch05-s04 formula, the ch14-s05 47%/18% line, the ch15-s05 rulings, the ch12-s08 user-estimate banner, the ch08-s05 layer-size card). Candle rule: whenever narration names a candle, rotate its label horizontal and enlarge it beside the flame for about 2s with its date range, and dim the neighbouring candles.

MAJOR (historian): publish the sources. At publish, generate a per-chapter sources page from the script claim ids -> claims.json sources and quotes.json URLs, add it to the manifest/shelf page, and point the ch15-s10 SOURCES card at it. The closing 'held to the same sources' disclosure must be checkable.

MAJOR (historian): quote integrity. The British-spelling voice pass altered a verbatim quote ('cheques'). Restore 'checks' in quotes.json q-lecun-checks, the ch06-s02 card and the L0603 caption/VTT. Add a guard so spelling passes never touch text inside quotation marks, and re-scan all 76 quotes for any other altered spellings.

MINOR (sound): pronunciation pipeline. Apply lexicon substitution inside explicit `spoken` text too (skip already-respelled tokens). Extend STT targets to every line with a proper noun from the cast list. Unify spellings (AlphaGo vs 'Alpha Go'; DeepSeek vs 'Deep Seek'). Keep quotation marks (or a colon and a pause) in `spoken` for every verbatim quote (L0108, L0303, L0405, L0609, L0610, L1518 and others).

MINOR (sound): mix floor and low end. Add a continuous room-tone/tape-hiss floor at about -55 to -60 LUFS (the m01 hiss: pink, hpf 2.5k) so the master never hits digital zero (276.7-278.4, 1699.3-1702.8, 1906.5-1908.5, and the last 17s over the end cards). Put a 35 Hz HPF (24 dB/oct) and a -2 to -3 dB low shelf at 120 Hz on the music bus, keyed to the narration sidechain. Then re-check that ducking reaches the 3 dB target.

MINOR (sound): QA checks that pass without measuring. lineLevels returns -14.79 for all 223 lines; measure each line's own window. Have film-score write lastStrike per cue, so fadeAfterStrike actually runs. Make the pacing warn list (any line >200 wpm outside deliberate staccato) a fail.

MINOR (teacher): voice the trade terms once. After a metaphor's first use, name the real term with a synced on-screen label: 'jug of light' -> softmax; 'below-zero rule' -> ReLU; 'snuff half' -> dropout; 'downhill in fog' -> gradient descent; 'memorised' -> overfitting. Add a label in ch11-s02 that models read word-pieces (tokens). Labels only, with no re-narration required.

PROCESS: after the line fixes, re-narrate only the touched lines (film-narrate shots subset), rebuild the clock, re-fit the affected shots and cues, re-assemble and re-sheet. The new line ids are L0524b, L0616, L1516b, the split of L1410 (L1410b) and the new ch06-s03b line. Story notes from script round 9 went unapplied (L1104, L1517, L1516b, the ch12 order, L0312, L0524b). Confirm each one lands in script.json before narration.

summary: Round 1 FAILS the gate. Weighted means: accuracy 7.67, depth 7.50, clarity 7.17, story 7.83, visual 7.50, sync 7.17, sound 6.67, curiosity 7.83; mean 7.42 (bar 8.5, every dimension >= 8). No critical issues. The bones are strong. Reviewers agree the candle-clock/case-file spine, the worked deep dives (stencil 3.88, the softmax jug, divide-by-sqrt(d_k), the XOR scissors) and the even-handed handling of contested history are excellent, and every quote and claim resolves. The gap is in execution. SOUND (6.67) is lowest: a rushed prologue, chunk-split ghost syllables, music masking key lines (m11 'Fair credit', m21 thesis line, m13 worked numbers, m17/m18), crossfades buried under chapter openers, unverified names in explicit spoken fields, and digital-zero holes. SYNC and CLARITY (7.17): key reveals land late or on black (ch10-s04, ch15-s09), the mechanism plates are framed too small (ch05-s04), meaningful text is too small to read, and foundations are crammed (pixels, position, dropout). VISUAL (7.5): generic figures, flat sets and a UI-like X-ray column. ACCURACY (7.67): an altered quote ('cheques'), the DeepSeek 'left out the chips' line, lab balance in ch12/ch15, and an unpublished sources card. STORY/CURIOSITY (7.83): unapplied round-9 notes (L1104, L1517, L1516b, ch12 order, L0312, L0524b) and an Act 3 news docket. Highest leverage, in order: (1) the sound globals (chunk splits, crossfades before openers, room-tone floor) plus the five cue fixes; (2) re-narrate the prologue and the respelled names; (3) the eight major shot fixes; (4) the round-9 story lines and the ch12 reorder; (5) quote integrity and a published sources page; (6) the kit-wide figure, set, X-ray and legibility upgrades.
